onslaught.name: Onslaught
onslaught.about: Twin and Power, melded. Twin's second blow, made heavy.
onslaught.frontText: Strikes twice, and the second blow lands at full strength instead of weaker, shoving what it hits a step back.
onslaught.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, at full strength.
onslaught.monsterText: Attacks twice; hits harder and has more life. Its second blow lands as hard as the first and knocks you back.

viper.name: Viper
viper.about: Twin and Poison, melded. Two fangs.
viper.frontText: A weaker hit that bites twice: two doses of poison at once, and its poison eats twice as fast (the same poison in half the time).
viper.behindText: Leaves two poison clouds; the second creeps toward the nearest enemy.
viper.monsterText: Attacks twice; poisons you. Each blow leaves two doses of poison on you.

flashfreeze.name: Flash Freeze
flashfreeze.about: Twin and Frost, melded. The first blow chills, the second freezes, all at once.
flashfreeze.frontText: Frost damage, striking twice: the first blow chills, the second freezes it on the spot (never a boss). A frozen enemy can't be flash-frozen again for a few seconds.
flashfreeze.behindText: Passes through and leaves ice twice: a second patch forms a moment after the first and freezes whatever stands in it.
flashfreeze.monsterText: Attacks twice; deals frost damage and slows you. If you are already chilled, its second blow freezes you for a moment.

rekindle.name: Rekindle
rekindle.about: Twin and Flame, melded. A fire that comes back.
rekindle.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; each burn lights again once when it goes out, as hot as before.
rekindle.behindText: Passes through and leaves burning ground that flares up once more after it dies down.
rekindle.monsterText: Attacks twice; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Its burn on you lights again once after it goes out.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.about: Twin and Swift, melded. Speed that turns into extra blows.
flurry.frontText: Faster to use again, and each use within a second of the last adds one more blow to it, up to four blows, each a little weaker.
flurry.behindText: Repeats itself sooner, and each repeat that lands gives you a burst of speed.
flurry.monsterText: Attacks twice; moves and attacks faster, and faster still while its blows keep landing on you.

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.about: Twin and Heavy, melded. The blow lands, then the ground answers.
aftershock.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; a moment later an aftershock bursts round where it hit, hurting and staggering everything near.
aftershock.behindText: Its cracked ground quakes twice, as it forms and again a second later, staggering whatever is on it both times.
aftershock.monsterText: Attacks twice; its blows knock you back. A moment after each blow, an aftershock bursts where you stood: step out of its ring.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.about: Leech and Power, melded. Healing you can't use becomes force.
bloodlust.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that heals you for every enemy it hits; while you are at full life, the healing becomes extra damage instead.
bloodlust.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs, and picking one up gives Power's damage bonus.
bloodlust.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; hits harder and has more life. At full life, its blows hit harder instead of healing it.

coldblood.name: Coldblood
coldblood.about: Leech and Frost, melded. Drinking the warmth out of what it freezes.
coldblood.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; it heals you twice as much from chilled or frozen enemies.
coldblood.behindText: Leaves ice that slows; enemies that die on the ice drop life orbs more often.
coldblood.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; deals frost damage and slows you. It heals twice as much while you are chilled.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.about: Leech and Lightning, melded. Life carried back along the bolt.
conduit.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; every enemy an arc strikes heals you too.
conduit.behindText: Leaves a storm; each enemy its bolts strike heals you a little.
conduit.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Its arcs heal the monsters they pass through.

secondwind.name: Second Wind
secondwind.about: Leech and Swift, melded. Each heal hurries you on.
secondwind.frontText: Faster to use again, and each time it heals you, its cooldown shortens a little more.
secondwind.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs, and picking one up gives you a burst of speed.
secondwind.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; moves and attacks faster. Each time it heals, it speeds up for a moment.

marrow.name: Marrow
marrow.about: Leech and Heavy, melded. Crush it, then drink.
marrow.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; hitting a stunned enemy heals you three times as much.
marrow.behindText: Its cracked ground drains a little life from whatever it staggers, for you.
marrow.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its blows knock you back. Knocking you back heals it a chunk.

quickfuse.name: Quickfuse
quickfuse.about: Volatile and Swift, melded. No wait between the kill and the blast.
quickfuse.frontText: Faster to use again; enemies it kills explode at once, and each explosion that kills shortens its cooldown a little.
quickfuse.behindText: Leaves a rune that goes off almost at once.
quickfuse.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; explodes when it dies. Its dying blast goes off at once, with no time to step away.

concussion.name: Concussion
concussion.about: Volatile and Heavy, melded. A blast that knocks the sense out of what it hits.
concussion.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; enemies it kills explode, and the blast stuns everything it catches.
concussion.behindText: Leaves a rune whose blast cracks the ground, staggering whatever walks over it after.
concussion.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; explodes when it dies. Its dying blast knocks you back and stuns you for a moment.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.about: Precise and Power, melded. Deadly one on one.
duelist.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; an enemy with no other enemy near it always takes a critical hit.
duelist.behindText: Marks an enemy; the marked one takes more damage from everything until the mark is spent.
duelist.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When you are alone, every hit from it is critical.

needle.name: Needle
needle.about: Precise and Poison, melded. The venom goes in exactly where it hurts.
needle.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; a critical hit puts three doses on at once.
needle.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical and doubles the poison already on it.
needle.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; poisons you. Its critical hits poison you three times over.

brand.name: Brand
brand.about: Precise and Flame, melded. A mark burned in.
brand.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and burns; a critical hit brands the enemy, and a branded enemy burns twice as hot.
brand.behindText: Marks an enemy with a burning brand: it burns until the mark is spent, and your next hit on it is a certain critical.
brand.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Its critical hits brand you: your burn runs twice as hot.

seeker.name: Seeker
seeker.about: Precise and Lightning, melded. Lightning that picks its target.
seeker.frontText: Lightning damage whose arcs jump to the enemies with the least life, and arcs can be critical hits too.
seeker.behindText: Marks an enemy; lightning from any of your moves arcs to the marked one first.
seeker.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, its hits are critical.

quickdraw.name: Quickdraw
quickdraw.about: Precise and Swift, melded. The first shot is the one that counts.
quickdraw.frontText: Faster to use again; the first use after two seconds without using it is a certain critical.
quickdraw.behindText: Marks an enemy; landing the marked critical gives you a burst of speed and shortens its cooldown.
quickdraw.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its first blow after a pause is critical.

pressurepoint.name: Pressure Point
pressurepoint.about: Precise and Heavy, melded. Strike the stunned where it's weakest.
pressurepoint.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; every hit on a stunned enemy is a certain critical.
pressurepoint.behindText: Its cracked ground marks whatever it staggers: your next hit on it is a certain critical.
pressurepoint.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its next blow after knocking you back is critical.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.about: Frenzied and Power, melded. The faster you go, the harder you hit.
berserk.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each use makes the next faster and harder, up to five times.
berserk.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each kill adds to Power's damage bonus.
berserk.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; hits harder and has more life. It hits harder too as it is hurt.

fever.name: Fever
fever.about: Frenzied and Poison, melded. The poison quickens with your pulse.
fever.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; each use while frenzied adds one more dose, up to five.
fever.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and a poisoned enemy dying holds it twice as long.
fever.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; poisons you. Its poison works faster the more hurt it is.

whiteout.name: Whiteout
whiteout.about: Frenzied and Frost, melded. A storm of blows that buries them in cold.
whiteout.frontText: Frost damage; each use makes the next faster, and the faster you are, the harder it slows.
whiteout.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going and freeze the enemies near the one that died for a moment.
whiteout.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; deals frost damage and slows you. The more hurt it is, the more it slows you.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.about: Frenzied and Lightning, melded. The current builds with every swing.
overcharge.frontText: Lightning damage; each use makes the next faster and adds one more arc, up to five.
overcharge.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each kill throws a bolt at the nearest enemy.
overcharge.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; deals lightning damage and shocks you. As it is hurt, its lightning arcs farther.

blur.name: Blur
blur.about: Frenzied and Swift, melded. Too fast to see.
blur.frontText: Faster to use again; at a full frenzy of five you also move faster and dodge more.
blur.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going and give you a burst of speed.
blur.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; moves and attacks faster. Badly hurt, it becomes a blur for a few seconds, very fast.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.about: Frenzied and Heavy, melded. Slow to start, impossible to stop.
juggernaut.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; each use makes the next faster, and at a full frenzy it is no slower at all.
juggernaut.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; at a full frenzy its cracked ground spreads twice as wide.
juggernaut.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows knock you back. The more hurt it is, the farther it knocks you.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.about: Guarding and Power, melded. Strong behind a strong shield.
bulwark.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each use gives you a brief shield, and while it holds your hits land harder.
bulwark.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast.
bulwark.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; hits harder and has more life. While its shield holds, it hits harder.

hemlock.name: Hemlock
hemlock.about: Guarding and Poison, melded. A shield that bites back.
hemlock.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; each use gives you a brief shield, and whatever strikes the shield is poisoned.
hemlock.behindText: Leaves a ward circle that poisons enemies standing in it.
hemlock.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; poisons you. Hitting its shield poisons you.

cinderward.name: Cinderward
cinderward.about: Guarding and Flame, melded. When the shield breaks, it burns.
cinderward.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and burns; each use gives you a brief shield that bursts in flame round you when it breaks or fades.
cinderward.behindText: Leaves a ward circle ringed in fire: enemies crossing its edge are set burning.
cinderward.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; deals fire damage and sets you burning. When its shield breaks, it bursts in flame.

static.name: Static
static.about: Guarding and Lightning, melded. Touch the shield and get shocked.
static.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs; each use gives you a brief shield, and whatever strikes the shield is struck by an arc.
static.behindText: Leaves a ward circle whose edge throws arcs at enemies inside it.
static.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Hitting its shield shocks you.

windward.name: Windward
windward.about: Guarding and Swift, melded. Sheltered and quick.
windward.frontText: Faster to use again; each use gives you a brief shield, and while it holds you move faster.
windward.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you move faster and take less damage.
windward.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; moves and attacks faster. While its shield holds, it is faster still.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.about: Guarding and Heavy, melded. Nothing moves you.
fortress.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; each use gives you a shield, and while it holds nothing knocks you back or stuns you.
fortress.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; enemies stepping into it are staggered.
fortress.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its blows knock you back. While its shield holds, nothing staggers or stops it.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.about: Lasting and Power, melded. Force that keeps building while you keep hitting.
momentum.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each hit that lands makes the next a little harder, and the build-up holds until you go three seconds without landing one.
momentum.behindText: Power's damage bonus lasts half again as long and builds two steps higher.
momentum.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; each blow it lands makes its next harder, until it stops landing them.

canker.name: Canker
canker.about: Lasting and Poison, melded. A poison that won't wear off.
canker.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; its poison lasts twice as long and doesn't wear off while you keep hitting.
canker.behindText: Leaves a poison cloud that lasts twice as long.
canker.monsterText: Its poison lasts longer on you; poisons you. Its poison doesn't wear off while it keeps hitting you.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.about: Lasting and Frost, melded. Cold that never lets go.
permafrost.frontText: Frost damage; its chill lasts twice as long, and what it freezes stays frozen half again as long.
permafrost.behindText: Leaves ice that slows and lasts until the fight is over.
permafrost.monsterText: Its chill lasts longer on you; deals frost damage and slows you. Its slow keeps deepening while you stay within its reach.

smoulder.name: Smoulder
smoulder.about: Lasting and Flame, melded. The fire outlives its fuel.
smoulder.frontText: Fire damage that explodes; burns last twice as long, and an enemy that dies burning leaves smouldering ground where it fell.
smoulder.behindText: Leaves burning ground that lasts much longer.
smoulder.monsterText: Its burning lasts longer on you; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Where it dies, the ground smoulders.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.about: Lasting and Lightning, melded. The storm stays.
tempest.frontText: Lightning damage; enemies it shocks stay shocked longer, and for three seconds arcs keep leaping between them.
tempest.behindText: Leaves a storm that lasts twice as long.
tempest.monsterText: Its shock lasts longer on you; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, small arcs keep striking you.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.about: Lasting and Swift, melded. Speed that stays with you.
tailwind.frontText: Faster to use again; each use also gives a burst of speed that lasts while you keep using it.
tailwind.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed that lasts half again as long.
tailwind.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; stays fast long after each blow.

bedrock.name: Bedrock
bedrock.about: Lasting and Heavy, melded. The ground stays broken.
bedrock.frontText: Slower, hits much harder, and its stun lasts half again as long.
bedrock.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that lasts until the fight is over.
bedrock.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; you stay staggered longer after each.

haymaker.name: Haymaker
haymaker.about: Fleeting and Power, melded. A hard blow with no warning.
haymaker.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit, and it lands sooner: less wind-up before the blow.
haymaker.behindText: Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast and fades in half the time.
haymaker.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows come with less warning.

bloat.name: Bloat
bloat.about: Fleeting and Poison, melded. The poison works fast, then bursts out.
bloat.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; its poison works in a third less time, and when it runs out the enemy bursts in a small cloud of it.
bloat.behindText: Leaves a poison cloud that fades fast and bursts on whatever is inside as it goes.
bloat.monsterText: Its poison hurts you faster; poisons you. When its poison on you runs out, it bursts round you.

coldsnap.name: Cold Snap
coldsnap.about: Fleeting and Frost, melded. A sudden, biting cold.
coldsnap.frontText: Frost damage; its chill is shorter but deeper, and hitting a chilled enemy snaps the chill off for extra damage.
coldsnap.behindText: Leaves ice that melts fast, freezing what stands on it as it goes.
coldsnap.monsterText: Its chill on you is short but deep; deals frost damage and slows you.

flashfire.name: Flashfire
flashfire.about: Fleeting and Flame, melded. Burns that go up all at once.
flashfire.frontText: Fire damage; its burns do all their harm in half the time, and a burn ending sends up a flare that hits those near.
flashfire.behindText: Leaves burning ground that burns hotter and dies faster.
flashfire.monsterText: Its burning hurts you faster; deals fire damage and sets you burning. When its burn on you ends, it flares.

jolt.name: Jolt
jolt.about: Fleeting and Lightning, melded. All the shock in one instant.
jolt.frontText: Lightning damage; a shocked enemy takes all of the shock's harm in a single jolt the next time you hit it.
jolt.behindText: Leaves a storm that lets loose all its bolts in one moment.
jolt.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its shock hits you all at once.

blink.name: Blink
blink.about: Fleeting and Swift, melded. Gone before they see you move.
blink.frontText: Faster to use again, and for a moment after each use you move very fast.
blink.behindText: Each use gives a burst of speed a third as long and much faster.
blink.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; darts at you in short, very fast bursts.

daze.name: Daze
daze.about: Fleeting and Heavy, melded. A short stun that leaves them wide open.
daze.frontText: Slower, hits much harder; its stun is shorter, but every hit on a stunned enemy lands harder.
daze.behindText: Its cracked ground staggers in quick, short jolts, more often.
daze.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; while you are staggered, it hits you harder.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.about: Vast and Power, melded. The bigger the crowd, the bigger the blow.
cataclysm.frontText: A much bigger area; the hit lands harder for every enemy it catches.
cataclysm.behindText: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits.
cataclysm.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its attacks reach much wider.

miasma.name: Miasma
miasma.about: Vast and Poison, melded. A haze that thickens as it spreads.
miasma.frontText: A weaker hit over a much bigger area that poisons everything it touches; the more enemies it poisons at once, the stronger each dose.
miasma.behindText: Leaves a poison cloud that slowly grows.
miasma.monsterText: Poisons you; its attacks reach wider and leave a haze of poison where they land.

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.about: Vast and Frost, melded. The cold spreads from one to the next.
glacier.frontText: Frost damage over a much bigger area; when it freezes an enemy, the ice spreads to those touching it and chills them.
glacier.behindText: Leaves a wide field of ice that slowly creeps outward.
glacier.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its attacks reach wider and frost the ground where they land.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.about: Vast and Flame, melded. Fire that runs across the floor.
inferno.frontText: Fire damage over a much bigger area; burning enemies set the ground alight where they walk.
inferno.behindText: Leaves burning ground that spreads outward for a few seconds.
inferno.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its attacks reach wider and set the ground alight.

stormfront.name: Stormfront
stormfront.about: Vast and Lightning, melded. One hit links the whole crowd.
stormfront.frontText: Lightning damage over a much bigger area; every enemy it hits is linked, and lightning flicks between linked enemies for a few seconds.
stormfront.behindText: Leaves a storm that drifts wide, striking anything in a much bigger area.
stormfront.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its attacks and its lightning reach wider.

gale.name: Gale
gale.about: Vast and Swift, melded. A sweep that clears the room.
gale.frontText: Faster to use again, a much bigger area, and it blows the enemies it hits back to its edge.
gale.behindText: Each use gives a burst of speed to you and every ally near you.
gale.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its attacks reach wider and push you away.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.about: Vast and Heavy, melded. The stun rolls out like a wave.
earthquake.frontText: Slower, hits much harder, and its stun rolls out in a wide wave from where it lands, reaching the far side a moment late.
earthquake.behindText: Leaves a wide field of cracked ground.
earthquake.monsterText: Its blows knock you back from much farther away.

twin2.name: Twin II
twin2.about: Two Twin, melded: Twin at level 2.
twin2.frontText: Strikes, fires or bursts three times, each a little weaker.
twin2.behindText: Repeats itself twice, each repeat weaker.

leech2.name: Leech II
leech2.about: Two Leech, melded: Leech at level 2.
leech2.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, half as much again.
leech2.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs more often.
leech2.monsterText: Heals when it hits you, half as much again.

volatile2.name: Volatile II
volatile2.about: Two Volatile, melded: Volatile at level 2.
volatile2.frontText: Enemies it kills explode, half as big and hard again.
volatile2.behindText: Leaves a rune that detonates half as big and hard again.
volatile2.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, half as hard again.

precise2.name: Precise II
precise2.about: Two Precise, melded: Precise at level 2.
precise2.frontText: More damage still, a smaller area still.
precise2.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next two hits on it are certain criticals.
precise2.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour, half as much again.

frenzied2.name: Frenzied II
frenzied2.about: Two Frenzied, melded: Frenzied at level 2.
frenzied2.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, each step half as big again, up to five times.
frenzied2.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, half as long again.
frenzied2.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, half as much again.

guarding2.name: Guarding II
guarding2.about: Two Guarding, melded: Guarding at level 2.
guarding2.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield, half as big again.
guarding2.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you take even less damage.
guarding2.monsterText: Carries a shield half as big again.

lasting2.name: Lasting II
lasting2.about: Two Lasting, melded: Lasting at level 2.
lasting2.frontText: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
lasting2.behindText: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
lasting2.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer still on you.

fleeting2.name: Fleeting II
fleeting2.about: Two Fleeting, melded: Fleeting at level 2.
fleeting2.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
fleeting2.behindText: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
fleeting2.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster still.

vast2.name: Vast II
vast2.about: Two Vast, melded: Vast at level 2.
vast2.frontText: An even bigger area, a little less damage.
vast2.behindText: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits.

swift2.name: Swift II
swift2.about: Two Swift, melded: Swift at level 2.
swift2.frontText: Faster to use again, half as much again.
swift2.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed, half as big again.
swift2.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster, half as much again.

heavy2.name: Heavy II
heavy2.about: Two Heavy, melded: Heavy at level 2.
heavy2.frontText: Slower, hits harder still, and stuns half as long again.
heavy2.behindText: Leaves wider cracked ground that staggers longer.
heavy2.monsterText: Its blows knock you back farther.

gear: Weapon, gloves, ring, amulet: Critical Chance or Dexterity, with Fire Damage or Fire Resistance.
Off hand, helm, chest, belt, boots: Critical Damage or Dexterity, with Fire Resistance.

Off hand, helm, chest, belt, boots: Critical Damage or Dexterity, with Dodge or Dexterity.

gear: Weapon, gloves, ring, amulet: Critical Chance or Dexterity, with Chance to Stun or Strength.
Off hand, helm, chest, belt, boots: Critical Damage or Dexterity, with Armour or Strength.
aftershock.note: One property of each, each a quarter weaker than alone. Two of a kind never pair.

gear: Weapon, gloves, ring, amulet: Life on Hit or Life on Kill, with Physical Damage, Added Damage or Strength.
Off hand, helm, chest, belt, boots: Max Life or Life Regen, with Armour or Strength.

gear: Weapon, gloves, ring, amulet: Life on Hit or Life on Kill, with Frost Damage or Frost Resistance.
Off hand, helm, chest, belt, boots: Max Life or Life Regen, with Frost Resistance.
coldblood.note: One property of each, each a quarter weaker than alone. Two of a kind never pair.

gear: Weapon, gloves, ring, amulet: Life on Hit or Life on Kill, with Lightning Damage or Lightning Resistance.
Off hand, helm, chest, belt, boots: Max Life or Life Regen, with Lightning Resistance.
conduit.note: One property of each, each a quarter weaker than alone. Two of a kind never pair.
